milestones.title: Baseline and safe setup
milestones.goal: No product rewrite; baseline and synchronization are understood before fixes.

milestones.title: Paths, ordering and native execution
milestones.goal: Reliable argument boundaries, dependency selection, deterministic order and bounded commands.

milestones.title: PDF validation and non-destructive results
milestones.goal: Sources/existing outputs stay safe; partial success cannot masquerade as full success.

milestones.title: Focused usability and honest documentation
milestones.goal: Preserved defaults, small parameter set, useful diagnostics and measured PDF limitations.

milestones.title: Regression, CI and Windows acceptance
milestones.goal: Required real Windows/native evidence plus scoped, truthful compatibility claims.

milestones.title: Packaging and accepted release source
milestones.goal: Reviewed package workflow and merged immutable release-source commit R.

milestones.title: Publish, verify and close
milestones.goal: Only v1.0.0 is publicly released; exact assets, downloaded operation and final sync are verified.
